close_note_draft: Chunked sidecar/source reads now use a fixed 64KiB buffer with incremental SHA-256, preserve full-source StoredFile fingerprints and selected-range FileRef hashes, reject corrupt or length-mismatched sidecars, and move the single final String through raw expand/ToolResponse without the prior two payload clones. Focused streaming tests pass 3/3. Candidate 10MB/100MB wall and sampled peak RSS, baseline wall deltas, copy inventory, and the single-message JSON-RPC first-byte limitation are recorded here.

conclusion: Materialization starts to dominate at the 10MB size class (p50 engine time is both the largest component and more than 50% of p50 wall time).

after: fixed 64KiB read buffer incrementally hashes into one Vec whose allocation transfers to the final String; raw selection and ToolResponse assembly move that String without payload clones
before: fs::read_to_string owns the full sidecar/source payload
engine expansion_response(target.clone()) clones the full payload
wire: serde/JSON-RPC still serializes one complete JSON message and therefore owns a separate framing/output buffer

first_byte_disclosure: First-byte refers only to the server-side file read beginning immediately in fixed chunks. MCP stdio returns one newline-delimited JSON-RPC message, so the client cannot receive a valid response first byte until the full ToolResponse has been serialized; this change does not claim client-visible streaming.

methodology.attribution: resource://tokenzero/metrics last_attribution_us after every operation; engine_us is labeled materialization, persist_us is persistence, framing is non-negative client wall residual
methodology.expand: one unmeasured warm-up followed by N tz_expand(ref) round trips; wall timer surrounds request write, flush, response readline, before JSON parsing
methodology.framing_scope: JSON serialization, response formatting, pipe scheduling, response bytes, and client overhead; JSON parsing occurs after the wall timer
methodology.ingest: tz_read(path, fresh=true, raw=true), then recursively extract returned tz:// or fz:// ref
methodology.limitations: engine_us is the existing server engine timer and may include store lookup in addition to byte materialization; RSS is sampled rather than an OS high-water mark; small-n p95/p99 are descriptive interpolations
methodology.payload: deterministic repeated SHA-256 hex line, exact byte length; temporary directory removed automatically
methodology.rss: server RSS sampled with ps immediately after each expand response; peak is the maximum observed sample for the size class and may understate a transient serialization peak
methodology.transport: one warm tokenzero mcp-server process per invocation over newline-delimited stdio JSON-RPC; serial tools/call requests; --only runs accumulate size classes in the evidence file
